results.statement: The integral inner-product space of smooth sections of a smooth Hermitian bundle on a compact Riemann surface has a complete Cauchy-class completion, with bounded linear extensions.
For positive periods a,b and every integer s>=0, the smooth periodic Sobolev completion is isometrically the weighted coefficient space with weights (1+m^2+n^2)^s; Fourier polynomials are dense.

Global smooth L2 and integer Sobolev completions inject into chart test distributions; bounded localization and the explicit dbar Fourier multiplier recognize completed weak derivatives and local smooth solutions.
A continuous compactly supported chart coefficient admits uniform smooth compactly supported approximants and therefore represents the same test pairings in the smooth L2 completion.

retained_prerequisites: Real completeness and elementary smooth calculus
Existence and finite additivity of continuous Riemann integrals
scope: These proofs construct smooth completions and their specified weak-test maps. They do not supply general measurable L2 representation, algebraic cohomology/GAGA or the arithmetic inputs of Section6.1.
